CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Making choices? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Making choices with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Making choices to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Making choices has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Making choices.

2. Which response best shows understanding of My Family Family members? (1 mark)
   A. Say My Family Family members has no place in daily life.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Annunciation? (1 mark)

8. Which response best shows understanding of Thoughts and feelings? (1 mark)
   A. Use Thoughts and feelings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Thoughts and feelings has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Thoughts and feelings.
   D. Apply the teaching of Thoughts and feelings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

10. Which response best shows understanding of Balaam’s Donkey? (1 mark)

   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

14. Which response best shows understanding of Samson kills a Lion? (1 mark)

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zacchaeus the Tax Collector.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
